prompts.text: Memorize: A, 7, K, Q. The host will hide it — what was the third item?

Memorize: 42, 17, 8. What was the first number?
Memorize: sprint, retro, planning, review. Which came third?
Memorize: coffee, tea, juice, water. What was the last drink?
Memorize: alpha, beta, gamma. What was the middle letter?
